versions.text: Criterion: Verify that control margins have been defined and assessed for safety of flight. Standard: The air vehicle meets the standards within MIL-STD-1797, 5.1.3 Control margin (see table XVIII and figures 17 and 18 for guidance). Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis, simulation, and inspection of requirements, design, and configuration documentation.

Standard: For all normal, extreme, and failure states, there is adequate control margin (aerodynamic control power, control surface rate, propulsion control, and hinge moment capability) for restoring moments throughout the RORH. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis and simulation to assess the control margin as specified within MIL-STD- 1797, Control Margin paragraph and Control Power for Stall Recovery paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess the air vehicle's control margin as specified within MIL-STD-1797, Control Margin paragraph and Control Power for Stall Recovery paragraph for each combination of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess the air vehicle's control margin as specified within MIL-STD-1797, Control Margin paragraph and Control Power for Stall Recovery paragraph for selected combinations of regions of handling qualities, air vehicle states, flight phases, and environmental conditions.
